Questions people actually ask

How many sessions will I need?

Most pigmentation courses run three to six sessions, four weeks apart. Your clinician will give you a number at consultation based on what they see, not an average.

Is it safe on brown skin?

Pico is generally the safer choice on deeper skin tones because it puts less heat into the tissue. It still requires a patch test and a clinician who has treated your skin type before.

Will it come back?

It can, and with melasma it usually does without maintenance. Daily SPF 50 is the difference between a result that holds and one that does not.

One consultation. A straight answer.
